svg.title: A-100 Ground Floor Plan
svg.text: LEVEL +0.00 · SCALE 1:50 @ A1 · ALL DIMENSIONS IN METRES
Masonry wall cut by section — 200 mm partition, 300 mm external / party
Internal stud or block partition, 120 mm
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab over)
1. Living, dining and kitchen read as one space, linked by 2.00 m and 1.50 m
wide arched openings; arch heads are shown dashed.
2. South elevation glazing to the living room and TV lounge is arched and
3. Guest bath and laundry are internal rooms: mechanical extract to the light
court at six air changes per hour.
4. The guest bedroom takes daylight from the light court through the party
wall, and is 4.00 × 3.50 m clear of the fitted wardrobe.
5. Gross internal area excludes the light court.
Preliminary design issue — not for construction. Do not scale from this drawing;
work to figured dimensions only and verify all levels and site boundaries before work.
